observations: Tall steel cabinet with four doors.
Upper section features two glass-paneled doors with visible internal shelves.
Lower section features two solid steel doors.
Handles and locks with keys are visible on both the upper and lower sections.
The item is situated in a warehouse or factory environment with stacked cardboard in the background.
A watermark 'GRACIOUS FURNITURES LTD' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Requires physical inspection of the lock mechanisms and the gauge of the steel.
The watermark suggests this is a stock or showroom photo rather than the specific unit for sale.

risks.risk: The photo appears to be a stock image, so the actual condition of the item is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the cabinet in a domestic or office setting with a handwritten note of the current date.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used item with significant cosmetic wear and tear.

risks.risk: The locks may be non-functional or keys may be missing/mismatched.
risks.proof: A video showing both the upper and lower locks being operated with the keys.

risks.risk: Internal shelves in the lower solid-door section may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo with all four doors fully open.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing internal shelving in the lower section.

risks.risk: Hidden structural damage or rust on the back and side panels.
risks.proof: Photos showing the rear and both side panels of the cabinet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having minor dents or surface rust.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual cabinet in its current location with a handwritten note showing today's date.
Photo with all doors open to confirm the presence and condition of all internal shelves.
Video demonstrating the keys working in both locks.
Photos of the back and side panels to check for dents or rust.
response.reason: The item is a standard 4-door steel office cabinet. Although the photo is likely a stock image from a furniture company, the item type is clearly identified and can be priced at its worst-case used value.
